blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—No bettor hit the P563.29-million Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot or the P30.63-million Mega Lotto 6/45 prize in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026. The winning combination for Ultra Lotto 6/58 was 51-22-34-27-01-24, carrying a jackpot prize of P563.29 million. However, no ticket matched all six winning numbers, according to PCSO results. Mega Lotto 6/45 also produced no jackpot winner. The winning combination was 31-24-26-04-42-09, with a jackpot prize of ₱30.63 million.
